title: RECREATION RESOURCE MANAGEMENT
description: Overview of recreation resource management including study of land and water resources used for outdoor recreation. The planning and management of natural and cultural resources for long-term resource productivity, with a focus on rural and wildlife areas of the forest, range and coast.
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
meeting_html: TR 12pm-1:50pm in PFSC 117 - Peavy Forest Science Center 117 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
